name: rsi_divergence_vwap_5s
author: adapted from quant_system
thesis: When price makes a new intraday low but RSI does not (bullish divergence), it signals exhaustion of selling pressure. Combined with proximity to VWAP from below, this creates a high-probability mean-reversion setup. The inefficiency exists because divergence is a lagging signal — most traders either don't compute it in real-time or don't trust it without discretionary confirmation. Not fully arbitraged because divergence signals are subjective (how many bars between pivots?) and hard to systematize cleanly.
mechanism: Short-term selling exhausts available demand at a price level, creating a temporary liquidity vacuum. Market makers who absorbed the selling begin marking prices back to reduce inventory risk. Limit buy orders resting below create a floor, and new participants entering the long side accelerate the reversion as the forced selling pressure dissipates.

indicators.name: price_pivot_low
indicators.formula: lowest low in last 20 bars (with 5-bar lookback on each side)

conditions: bearish_divergence == True (price higher high, RSI lower high)

filters.volume_filter: volume at pivot must be > SMA(volume, 20)

weaknesses: Divergence detection is inherently subjective. The 'pivot low' definition (5 bars each side) is arbitrary and different lookback windows produce different signals.
In strong trends, divergences can persist for 100+ bars before reversing — you can get 3-4 false divergences before the actual reversal.
Profit factor of 1.10 is razor-thin. Transaction cost assumptions must be dead-on or the strategy is negative expectation.
prior_art: RSI divergence is textbook TA. See: Constance Brown, Andrew Cardwell. The VWAP proximity filter is the specific addition here.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; apply to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index instead of FnO universe; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
